en: Old black‑and‑white postcard showing a large three‑storey corner building with many uniform windows and a small tower or cupola on the roof. People in early 20th‑century clothing stand and walk along a cobblestone street in front of the building. Printed red text at the upper right identifies the scene as a location in Theresienstadt and specifies a particular imperial building.
